findings.issue: מִקְשָׁה (H4749) is a feminine singular noun of hammered or beaten work; “de martillo” names the tool hammer and drops the work.
הַכַּפֹּרֶת is a definite common noun (H3727); “kappóret” leaves that non-name lemma untranslated.

notes: Y harás, dos querubines de oro, harás a ellos, and desde dos extremos match the two qal 2ms verbs, the dual two, the plural cherubim, gold, the 3mp object, and min with the dual-construct two of the ends.
